newsitem.title: USA: Ensec completes $1.1 mln ADT order.
newsitem.headline: Ensec completes $1.1 mln ADT order.

text.p: Ensec International Inc said on Friday it had completed a $1.1 million order for a security system from ADT Security Services Inc.
Ensec, which makes the systems, has a strategic partnership agreement with ADT, which provides electronic security services.
ADT Security Services is a unit of ADT Ltd.
"Since our IPO (initial public offering) last September we have booked orders of approximately $5.5 million for our systems," it said.
On Thursday, Ensec reported a share loss of $1.63 for fiscal 1996, compared to a loss of $0.98 a year ago.
